title: Horizontal pasting of canonical duality mates on the iterated pullback
statement: Let f:X→Y be qcqs, g:Y′→Y and h:Z→Y′ morphisms with Y,Y′,Z qcqs, and fix derived module categories in one universe [def-pc-derived-category, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let X′=X×_Y Y′, P=X′×_{Y′} Z, Q=X×_Y Z [def-pc-fibre-product], and let e:P≅Q be canonical pullback associativity. Choose a,a′,d,c right adjoints to the lifted derived direct images for X→Y, X′→Y′, P→Z, Q→Z, with supplied adjunctions [lem-pc-qcqs-derived-direct-image-right-adjoint]. Assume ordinary derived base change for (f,g), (X′→Y′,h), and (f,h≫g) is invertible on every quasi-coherent input [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. For K∈D_QCoh(Y), let μ,ν,λ be their respective canonical duality mates [def-sc-duality-equation-base-change-map], with ν evaluated at Lg* K. Then the arrow L(pr₁:P→X′)*μ ≫ ν is isomorphic in Arrow(D(O_P)) to L(e.hom)*λ. Neither μ nor ν nor λ is assumed invertible. No open subschemes, restriction functors, or supplied isomorphisms q,r,δ occur in this statement.

proof.text: Use canonical pullback associativity e:P≅Q and derived pullback composition to compare the source endpoints. Lift the direct-image composition comparison for e to the QCoh categories. Pullback along e is an equivalence; transport the two direct-image/right-adjoint adjunctions along this equivalence and use right-adjoint uniqueness to identify d with c transported to P. Together with derived pullback composition for h≫g this gives the target endpoint comparison. These are the canonical comparisons determined by the adjunctions, not arbitrary endpoint isomorphisms.

Follow the diagram in the proof of Stacks Lemma 48.5.2 (0ATR). Expand each canonical duality mate into the pullback of the right adjoint applied to the base unit, the pullback of the inverse conjugate of ordinary base change, and the top pullback counit. Naturality gives the commuting quadrilaterals of that diagram. Composite adjunction units and counits and the triangle identities reduce the equality to the equality of conjugates: the outer conjugate is the first conjugate whiskered with the second base direct image after the second conjugate whiskered with the first top direct image. This is the conjugate of ordinary horizontal base-change pasting (0ATM), so holds under the same composition comparisons. Invert the conjugates, compose the resulting commuting square with the endpoint comparisons of step 1, and apply Arrow.isoMk. Only ordinary base-change conjugates are inverted. Tor-independence in the source is used only to ensure ordinary base-change invertibility; here these invertibilities are explicit hypotheses. Empty schemes and zero K need no exception.

theorem horizontal_duality_mate_pasting
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X Y Y' Z : Scheme.{u}}
    [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y] [CompactSpace Y'] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y']
    (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (a : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (a' : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y' ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory (pullback f g))
    (adjf : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f) (fun E ↦
        (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint X Y
          (QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f)
          (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f) _ _ _ _ f _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ a)
    (adjf' : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y').lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback f g)).ι ⋙
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)) (fun E ↦
        (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint _ _ _
          (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f g)) _ _ _ _
          (pullback.snd f g) _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ a')
    (hβ : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g (pullback.fst f g)
        pullback.condition E.obj))
    (K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y)
    [CompactSpace Z] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Z]
    (h : Z ⟶ Y')
    (c : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z ⥤
      schemeDerivedQCohCategory (pullback f (h ≫ g)))
    (adjc : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Z).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback f (h ≫ g))).ι ⋙
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f (h ≫ g))) (fun E ↦
        (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint _ _ _
          (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f (h ≫ g))) _ _ _ _
          (pullback.snd f (h ≫ g)) _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ c)
    (hβh : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f (h ≫ g)) (h ≫ g)
        (pullback.fst f (h ≫ g)) pullback.condition E.obj))
    (d : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z ⥤
      schemeDerivedQCohCategory (pullback (pullback.snd f g) h))
    (adjd : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Z).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback (pullback.snd f g) h)).ι ⋙
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h)) (fun E ↦
        (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint _ _ _
          (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h))
          _ _ _ _ (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h) _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ d)
    (hβ₂ : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory (pullback f g),
      IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap (pullback.snd f g)
        (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h) h
        (pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g) h) pullback.condition E.obj)) :
    Nonempty (Arrow.mk
      ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g) h)).map
        ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback f g)).ι.map
            (@dualityEquationBaseChangeMap _ X Y Y'
              (QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f)
              (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f) _ _ _ _
              f g a a' adjf adjf' hβ K)) ≫
        ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback (pullback.snd f g) h)).ι.map
            (@dualityEquationBaseChangeMap _ (pullback f g) Y' Z
              (QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace (pullback.snd f g))
              (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f g)) _ _ _ _
              (pullback.snd f g) h a' d adjf' adjd hβ₂
              (((schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y').lift
                ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).ι ⋙ derivedPullback g)
                (fun E ↦ (derivedPullback_tensor_preserve_QCoh g).1
                  E.obj E.property)).obj K)))) ≅
      Arrow.mk ((derivedPullback (pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso f g h).hom).map
        ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback f (h ≫ g))).ι.map
            (@dualityEquationBaseChangeMap _ X Y Z
              (QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f)
              (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f) _ _ _ _
              f (h ≫ g) a c adjf adjc hβh K))))
